body:
https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/issues/2146 - here one of the issue we are working on on Hive Mind side.

Please also take most critical issues from open issues in https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/issues and try closing them in one go (in a single pull request here).

Note, not to take issues, which are executing already at https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/pulls

Be free to use architectural changes as needed to introduce more generalization of logic not less according to our vision, goals, etc. Don't afraid to introduce conflicts with other pull requests if needed, it is easy to transfer requirements, that already implemented to new architecture.

Yet, try keep improving all our associative technological stack at the same time, meaning you can do workarounds in this repository, create an issue to replace workarounds with actual solutions, once associative technological stack dependencies are advanced enough, and report issues to all of them, where it will benefit to separation of concerns, improve flexibility, extensibility, and may benefit more projects, not only Formal AI itself, and also will reduce duplication of the code.

Also you may create issues, that will propose entirely new libraries/components, that look missing in our associative technological stack, if any.  

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until it is each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: A step to Formal AI being able to code itself, via Hive Mind
